name: Rock-Paper-Scissors Lattice
desc: Three species locked in a cyclic dominance loop — each one voids its prey, floods bare ground and simply swaps places with whoever it meets — so no one can ever win and the plate stays alive as entangled rotating domains, mobility widening the spiral arms until biodiversity nearly crashes and a rescue invasion lands a fresh colony on the dead ground.

mobility.doc: pair-exchange rate — sets spiral wavelength; low = tight entangled arms, high = coarse spirals that outgrow the plate and crash into churn

density.doc: reproduction pressure — how hard species flood bare ground (low = open plate, high = packed)

speed.doc: Monte-Carlo step rate (how fast the ecology runs)

hue.doc: first pigment hue; the other two sit 120 degrees away

style.doc: aesthetic — agar pigment plate / saturated biodiversity map / three ink densities on toned paper / abstracted turnover heatmap with species identity dissolved / darkfield washes with burning fronts

act.doc: multi-minute program — steady coexistence / forced periodic invasions / slow mobility ramp that drives biodiversity to the edge and back over ~5 minutes

seed.doc: seeds the initial sowing and every rescue invasion
